name: LoadoutSwitcher
description: Hotkey switching of saved in-game loadouts (Role Plans), with toast feedback.
author: Stellar

media.caption: Stellar Settings — Hotkeys: the loadout group with apply.1–apply.8 bindings.

changed: Your Deep-Slumber bindings are now stored in the plugin's own data folder; existing bindings are carried over automatically on first launch.
fixed: Switching to the loadout you already wear no longer re-equips everything, and rapid presses respect the game's three-second switch cooldown (needs framework 2.6.0).
